quantity_returned: MACE-MP-0 medium relaxed energy per atom -> formation energy vs MACE elemental refs (O from relaxed O2 in a 12 A box) and e_above_hull vs MACE-relaxed MP phases of the system (binaries <=30 sites, ternaries <=80)
defining_paper: Batatia et al., A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry (MACE-MP-0), arXiv 2401.00096
accuracy_on_scored_quantity: none: the scored quantity is EQE; stability is a proxy for which phase forms (checked at I4)
what_it_is_not: not DFT; no MP2020 anion/U corrections; no magnetism; no finite-temperature or kinetic (thin-film, 610-850 C anneal) effects; not an EQE predictor
conventions: float64, FIRE + FrechetCellFilter, fmax 0.05 eV/A, max 150 steps (unconverged relaxations are not flagged)
O2 reference is a MACE molecule, not the fitted MP O2 correction
hull built only from MP phases in M-Sb-O (other elements' oxides missing -> lower bound, flagged)
disagreements: the literature MACE-MP-0 hull numbers are computed against MP-corrected DFT references; this card's hull uses MACE-only references, so absolute ehull differs from MP ehull
150-step cap: the paper relaxes to convergence; large cells may stop unconverged
binary polymorphs above 30 sites are excluded (A-02); the paper's hull has no such cap
name: mace_stability
completeness: Card written from bench/fm.py::mace_relax, formation_energy, ref_energy; runtime/mcp/server.py::mace_stability; checked against Batatia et al., A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry (MACE-MP-0), arXiv 2401.00096; 3 disagreement(s) listed, none reconciled.
